confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Siem Reap's tourist price levels, not from live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are the most reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because hotel and hostel rates vary widely by season, booking channel, and exact location, and July is green-season, so rates are likely at the lower end of the annual range. Cocktail and wine anchors are estimated from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from a search snippet attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Southeast Asian tourist hubs with similar backpacker and mid-range visitor markets, such as Phnom Penh, Luang Prabang, Hoi An, and Vientiane, adjusted to Siem Reap's Angkor-driven tourism pricing.
